text.section:
No home protection contract shall be cancelable by the home protection company during the initial term for which it is issued, except for:
Nonpayment of premium;
Fraud or misrepresentation of facts material to the issuance of the contract; or
Contracts providing coverage prior to the time the residential property is purchased, provided that purchase of the property does not occur.
Nothing in this section establishes the right of a contract holder to renew any contract.
